content:
Emma (Sales): FYI Euroscale wants SOC2 artifacts + pen-test letter + staging KMS diagram for the POC. Link to their questionnaire: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/euroscale-poc-q
Raj (RevEng): timeline? can we deliver a minimal pack in 3 business days? Also will this trigger Dedicated/pricing implications?
Miguel (SRE): we can provide a network diagram + ephemeral staging creds. Need to know if they require on-prem or customer-managed KMS — that changes scope.
Olga (Security): We can share the SOC2 AOC (redacted), control narratives and a penetration-test attestation summary. For a formal pen-test letter signed by our CISO/legal, I can draft it but will need Legal sign-off. We cannot share raw vuln reports.
Emma (Sales): they specifically asked for KMS flow diagrams showing customer-managed keys. @Olga is that something we can map without pulling Legal in?
Olga (Security): Yes we can map the architecture and the responsibilities matrix. But if they want a claim like "customer keys never leave your environment" we need the Private deployment details called out. That becomes an implementation option in the SOW.
Raj (RevEng): pricing heads-up: Private + CMK integration increases onboarding effort (infra + ops). Ballpark: +2-3 weeks engineering + one-time integration fee. I'll formalize numbers once we know requirement.
Miguel (SRE): For the POC staging creds, plan is ephemeral tokens + ip allowlist. Example token generator curl:
```
# generate one-time token (valid 24h)
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/token -d '{"env":"euroscale"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY"
```
We will not include any KMS material in the pack.
Emma (Sales): also asked about pen-test scope: external (blackbox) vs internal. Which do we normally attest to?
Olga (Security): We routinely provide an attestation that we perform annual external penetration tests and remediation summaries. If they require a vendor-signed letter from our external tester, we can request that but it may take extra lead time and cost — typically 1-2 weeks to coordinate.
onboarding-bot: Draft evidence bundle uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/euroscale/poc-evidence-draft.zip :file_folder:
Raj (RevEng): Action items:
1) Emma to ask Euroscale for CIDR/IP ranges and clarify pen-test scope (internal vs external vendor).
2) Olga to draft SOC2 redacted set + pen-test attestation letter (for Legal/CISO signature).
3) Miguel to prepare network diagram + ephemeral token instructions and sample commands.
4) Raj to compute price delta for Private/CMK option and onboarding timeline.
ETA: Tue EOD (3 business days).
Emma (Sales): I'll ping the customer now and update this thread. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
